text:
maria (sales): Hey team — AcmeHealth security reached out asking for a packet of auth controls for their vendor risk review. They specifically want: IdP SAML metadata, MFA enforcement proof (policy + sample logs), RBAC role exports/screenshots, and a short note on least-privilege practices. Can we assemble this by EOD Thu? cc @ken
ken (solutions): On it. I can produce SAML metadata (IdP) and SP test metadata. Quick question: do they want SP-initiated specifics and SLO details included?
emma@acmehealth: IdP metadata yes. Also: proof that MFA is enforced for all interactive admin console logins (not just API keys). We need audit trail for MFA successes/fails for the last 90 days.
jordan (security): We can generate MFA policy doc + aggregated auth logs with usernames. We should confirm whether we need raw IPs in the logs or if redaction is required. Also will map SIG/CAIQ controls to the artifacts (CCM_AAC_01 etc).
maria (sales): Legal flagged username sharing — they prefer usernames but may accept pseudonymized IDs. I'll escalate to legal and get back within 24h. Timeline still EOD Thu pending that.
ken (solutions): For RBAC I'll export the role definitions and include JSON role maps + screenshots of the Roles UI. Sample role map below:
```json
[
  {"role":"admin","permissions":["deploy","config:edit","keys:view"]},
  {"role":"ops","permissions":["deploy","logs:view"]},
  {"role":"dev","permissions":["models:invoke","models:list"]}
]
```
jordan (security): We'll also include a short section on service accounts: all service accounts are issued short-lived tokens via our STS (default max 24h) and we rotate long-lived credentials every 90 days. Will include the policy excerpt.
ken (solutions): SAML fragment to include (signed metadata file attached in packet):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <!-- simplified snippet -->
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
ken (solutions): Sample audit log lines (we will redact PII/IPs if requested):
```
2026-03-10T14:23:11Z user:bob@acmehealth MFA:ok method:totp ip:1.2.3.4
2026-03-12T09:01:02Z user:alice@acmehealth MFA:fail method:sms ip:5.6.7.8
```
jordan (security): For SIG/CAIQ mapping I'll create a table: e.g., CCM_AAC_01 -> SSO enforced (artifact: saml-metadata.xml), CCM_AAC_02 -> MFA enforcement (artifact: mfa-policy.pdf + logs), CCM_AAC_03 -> RBAC (artifact: roles.json + screenshots).
maria (sales): Plan: Ken & Jordan to assemble packet by Wed EOD; I will review and send to Acme Thu morning. If legal requires signed addendum for username-level logs, that may push timeline — I'll update.
audit-bot: artifact-uploader: uploaded auth-controls-packet-1825001111.tar.gz -> https://secure-share.company/AcmeHealth/1825001111 (access: secure link, internal only)
ken (solutions): Will include: RBAC UI screenshots, console policy page screenshot (MFA required toggle visible), signed SAML metadata file, role JSON export, service account policy note, and a short POC test plan for validating SSO. Any other asks?
emma@acmehealth: If you can also include an example SP metadata used in our test POC and a test checklist (steps we run to validate SSO + MFA) that would be great.
ken (solutions): Noted — will add SP test metadata and a 6-step SSO validation checklist.
maria (sales): Thanks everyone — marking high priority. Jordan/legal, please chime if username sharing is a blocker.
jordan (security): Legal: please confirm acceptable level of detail for audit logs. If Acme insists on plaintext usernames we need signed approval.
maria (sales): I'll loop legal and send an interim packet (no usernames) so Acme can start review. Follow-up with final packet once legal confirms. :thumbsup:
